GOV-F-004-S113.title: Audit Log Query API
GOV-F-004-S113.description: Implement secure backend API endpoints to query audit logs by trace_id, actor, action type, and time range, with pagination and access control for internal/admin use.
GOV-F-004-S113.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py (query + audit patterns); Code/Shared/brain_auth.py (access control); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S114.title: Audit Logging Integration Across Services
GOV-F-004-S114.description: Instrument key execution points (tool_router, safety_service, consent_service, brain_runner, GPTReader) to emit standardized audit events for all GPT and Claude operations.
GOV-F-004-S114.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/tool_router.py (execution hub); Code/Shared/brain_runner.py (GPT orchestration); Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py (existing audit logging); Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/shared/safety/safety_service.py; RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S115.title: Append-Only Enforcement & Tamper Protection Tests
GOV-F-004-S115.description: Create unit and integration tests verifying audit records cannot be updated or deleted, ensuring append-only guarantees at application and database levels.
GOV-F-004-S115.evidence: Code/Shared/ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py (write patterns); Code/DataPipelines/tests/test_gpt_reader.py (audit validation patterns); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S116.title: End-to-End Audit Trace Validation
GOV-F-004-S116.description: Implement integration tests validating that a single user request produces a complete, correlated audit trail across FastAPI entrypoint, tool execution, and Brain orchestration using trace_id.
GOV-F-004-S116.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/main.py (request lifecycle); Code/Shared/brain_runner.py (multi-step orchestration); Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests/test_tool_router.py (integration patterns); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004
